criteria.requirement: Implement sqlglot.report_remap.remap_tables(query,mapping,*,dialect=None,require_all=False). Reuse completed physical scope inspection; keys/values are exact (catalog,database,name) string tuples with optional empty prefixes. Quote replacement identifiers as data, never parse them as SQL. Rewrite physical named tables only, leaving CTE aliases and bodies/comments/literals otherwise compatible. Preserve existing aliases; for unaliased tables add original name as alias and repair matching scoped db/catalog-qualified columns to it. Keep table hints/other attributes. Reject malformed names and optional unused keys, return independent AST and retain source links. Do not string-replace SQL.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
